features.quote: `submit{status: done|give_up}` is deliberately included so the model has a *clean exit*
features.justification_quote: this is what lets us distinguish graceful disengagement from spiraling

features.quote: stop after 3 consecutive no-tool-call "thinking" turns; a wall-clock `episode_timeout_s`; and `max_output_tokens` per turn
features.justification_quote: prevent a single pathological episode from running up cost or hanging the run

features.quote: `early_stop_on_spiral` can halt an episode once a *stronger* deterministic detector fires
features.justification_quote: Cost lever for large sweeps: once a spiral is confidently underway, extra turns add cost
